If your purchase doesn’t work out, you have options as long as your item is eligible under our Returns Policy:

Online orders: You can return items within 14 days from the date of purchase via our online Returns Portal.
In-store purchases: You can return items to any CAMILLA Boutique within 14 days.
Exceptions: Certain items (e.g., hosiery, intimates, earrings, surfboards, face masks, gift cards, and items marked FINAL SALE - NO EXCHANGES - NO RETURNS) cannot be returned, exchanged, or refunded.
Exchanges: We do not exchange online orders at this time; full-priced in-boutique purchases may be exchanged or refunded.
How to return online: Submit your return through our portal, obtain an approved Return Authorisation Number (RA#) and label, write the RA# on your return form, then attach the label securely to your parcel and send it back.
